_comment: Known-vulnerable pinned dependencies. Empty is the goal state, and as of
2026-08-18 it IS empty: the six pins recorded when scanning was switched on
(2026-08-17) were all cleared by regenerating requirements.lock.
This is a RATCHET, not an amnesty. scripts/check_audit_baseline.py fails CI
for any vulnerable package NOT listed here, fails if a listed package's pin
changes while still vulnerable, and fails if a listed package has gone clean
(so this file cannot rot into a list of things that are no longer true).
Only add an entry when a fix genuinely cannot be taken yet -- record the
pinned version, the version that clears it, and WHY it is being deferred.
